name: Ben Sessions

about: Ben Sessions is 1 of only 4 lawyers in Georgia to be Board Certified in DUI Defense by the National College for DUI Defense. Ben's practice is focused on the defense of DUI and other serious driving offenses. Ben has been a speaker for the Georgia Probate Judges' Traffic Conference, the Georgia Municipal Court Judges' Law & Practice Update, the National College for DUI Defense, Georgia Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, Georgia Public Defender Standards Council, New York State Bar Association, and Georgia ICLE. Most recently, he served as the Co-Chair for ICLE's DUI 101 Seminar.
Ben has successfully litigated (and changed the law) in several important DUI and criminal defense cases before the Georgia Court of Appeals and Georgia Supreme Court.
